author_note_p1: Whew, that was certainly a lot to type through. But I felt it was worth it.
author_note_p2: Surprised by the upgrade? An interesting tidbit I should mention is that during the development of this fanfic (before being published) & before you guys started suggesting this idea, I heavily considered having Bell be able to wield a Keyblade and receive the Starlight Keyblade from Sora, because Sora is at Keyblade Master Level to unknowingly perform the Keyblade Inheritance Ceremony.
author_note_p3: Also, you don't need the Master title to perform the ceremony, as Terra has performed it without the title.
author_note_p4: It certainly seemed like a very fun idea to go with.
author_note_p5: But I soon found that having a Keyblade is just story-breaker power in itself, and Bell having it would make 95% of the conflict for him to be rendered meaningless.
author_note_p6: Having Sora around is enough already.
author_note_p7: So I've decided to go with the alternative of Sora giving Bell's Hestia Knife an upgrade, and give him a taste of Kingdom Hearts bullshit.
author_note_p8: Just as how certain weapons have the Durandal Attribute to prevent it from breaking and Curse Weapons have curses added to them, Bell's Hestia Knife has the Attribute of Light.
author_note_p9: That doesn't really mean Bell is going to be manipulating light to the same extent as Sora.
author_note_p10: The Light Attribute is ironically more subtle than flashy for Bell's Hestia Knife.
author_note_p11: Light is a rather versatile attribute, and has 3 Traits to it (because Kingdom Hearts number theme).
author_note_p12: And just what are they? You'll just have to read and find out later on.
author_note_p13: Also, please note that Bell's weapon is forged with the same material in canon: mythril.
author_note_p14: Adamantite was merely used as payment for the knife. The only addition to the knife is Electrum and Twilight Crystal.
author_note_p15: I've decided to add another factor that Sora can help influence Bell grow stronger.
author_note_p16: Namely, the Gummiphone. Let's say in my fanfic, the Gummiphone holds the data of all the battles that Sora has been in. Bell can see the records of Sora's battles and the data of the enemies he fought.
author_note_p17: Can't be too farfetched. I mean, Cid managed to somehow get data on the Organization 13 members and recreate their fighting styles.
author_note_p18: Even Xehanort and the X-blade, despite Sora being the only one to directly fight him.
author_note_p19: And seeing how Larxene is practically the only knife user in Kingdom Hearts, I figured Bell could learn a thing or two from her.
